Great question! Setting up your new Leesa products is designed to be quick and easy. Here’s a simple guide for your first time: 📦

1. Assemble the Base First:

Foundation: Assembly is tool-free! Just connect the side and end rails, push in the corner pins, add the center rail, and unroll the slats on top. For more details, see the Foundation assembly guide.
Bed Frame: This also features tool-free assembly. Just follow the instructions that come with your shipment.

2. Set Up the Mattress:

Move the box to your bedroom before opening.
Carefully unbox and place the rolled mattress on your assembled base.
Remove the plastic wrap and watch it expand! It can take up to an hour to take shape and a few days to fully firm up.

You can find the full mattress setup steps here: How do I set up my Leesa mattress?

3. Add Protection:

Once the mattress has expanded, you can zip the Mattress Encasement around it for full protection.
